answer.reason: The verses tell of the plate being set on Aaron's mitre at his consecration and of its purpose on his forehead.

clauses.english: was put on Aaron's mitre when he was consecrated
clauses.quote: did he put the golden plate, the holy crown

clauses.english: was worn on Aaron's forehead that he might bear the iniquity of the holy things
clauses.quote: that Aaron may bear the iniquity of the holy things

doubts: EXO 36:37 is marked but concerns the hanging for the tabernacle door, not the crown; left out.
